# STEREO Reels

> An agent skill that turns a long recording into short vertical clips. It transcribes
> the source with timecodes, lets the agent propose hooks, cuts what the human picks,
> then transcribes every finished clip again to prove the cut is not broken. Five small
> scripts, ffmpeg, one HTTP call to a speech recogniser. No local model, no framework.

The point of the project is the verification step: a clip is approved because the
recogniser, given only that clip, heard the words it was cut for — not because
someone watched it.

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the sequence an agent follows, including the two points where
  it must stop and ask a human — choosing hooks, and approving clips.
- [README.md](README.md): the problem, measured numbers from two real runs, and the
  reasoning behind re-encoding instead of stream copy.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules that are not visible from the code.

## Tools

- [tools/transcribe.py](tools/transcribe.py): media → segments with timecodes and an
  optional speaker timeline. Extracts audio locally first, so a 2 GB video uploads
  as ~12 MB.
- [tools/cut.py](tools/cut.py): exact cut from the original. `--quality draft` for
  review, `final` for approved clips.
- [tools/verify.py](tools/verify.py): re-transcribes a clip and reports four failure
  modes — `silence_head`, `silence_tail`, `text_drift`, `empty`.
- [tools/srt.py](tools/srt.py): subtitles with timecodes rebased to the clip.
- [tools/reframe.py](tools/reframe.py): landscape -> vertical. The camera path is built
  from motion (per-column frame differences), not face detection, so it needs no
  dependency beyond ffmpeg. `--anchor` forces a static crop.
- [tools/mcp_server.py](tools/mcp_server.py): the same operations as MCP tools over
  JSON-RPC/stdio. Standard library only, no SDK.

## Optional

- [.env.example](.env.example): the only configuration. Token comes from
  `/app` in @stereo_dictator_bot.
